title: Dinner in San Jose with a female crash retrieval program worker

tellings.quote: Oh, yeah. It was a woman. I met her. I we he my source, his wife, uh took me to her home, picked her up. We went into San Jose to have dinner at a German restaurant.

plain: Sometime between the late 1970s and 1989, according to Eric W. Davis, a scientist who appears on the show as a Pentagon scientist, he met a woman who had worked on a crash retrieval program, a secret effort to recover crashed craft of unknown origin. Davis tells Michels that his source's wife drove him to the woman's home, picked her up, and took them both to dinner at a German restaurant in San Jose, California. If true, it would put him face to face with someone who had worked inside such a program.
